optimized_sql:
select 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    count(*) as cnt1, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    count(*) as cnt2, 
    cd_credit_rating, 
    count(*) as cnt3 
from 
    customer c 
    inner join customer_address ca on c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
    inner join customer_demographics cd on cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
    where 
        ca.ca_state in ('IL','TX','ME') 
        and exists (
            select 1 
            from store_sales ss 
            inner join date_dim d on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
            where d.d_year = 2002 and d.d_moy between 1 and 3 
            and ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        ) 
        and not exists (
            select 1 
            from web_sales ws 
            inner join date_dim d on ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
            where d.d_year = 2002 and d.d_moy between 1 and 3 
            and ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        ) 
        and not exists (
            select 1 
            from catalog_sales cs 
            inner join date_dim d on cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
            where d.d_year = 2002 and d.d_moy between 1 and 3 
            and cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        ) 
group by 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    cd_credit_rating 
order by 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    cd_credit_rating 
limit 100
